questions.q: How did the mafia make money in Hollywood, according to the summary?
a: They lent cash to skilled filmmakers and took the profits
They bought every major studio outright
They sold cameras and equipment to film crews
They provided security for movie sets
questions.why: Lesson 1 says they funded talented but broke Eastern European filmmakers.

questions.q: Why did the mob leave Sicily for New York?
a: Mussolini's fascists drove them out
A treaty forced them to relocate
Earthquakes destroyed their homes
New York offered them legal work
questions.why: Lesson 1 says fascist rule under Mussolini chased them away.

questions.q: What was Hoover's secret that the mafia used against him?
a: His relationship with his deputy Clyde Tolson
His ownership of several illegal casinos
His ties to a foreign government
His failure to finish law school
questions.why: Lesson 2 says the mob had evidence and blackmailed him over it.

questions.q: How did Hoover publicly handle organized crime?
a: He denied that a national criminal network existed
He announced a nationwide crackdown on crime
He testified against his own agents in court
He resigned from the bureau and left the country
questions.why: Lesson 2 says he kept denying organized crime even as evidence mounted.

questions.q: What made Crosswell suspect a mafia gathering in Apalachin?
a: A large order of luxury food and rooms for a specific date
A tip from a local newspaper journalist
A sudden drop in local hotel prices
A letter sent to the police chief
questions.why: Lesson 3 says he noticed Joseph Barbara's expensive preparations and staked out the villa.
